The company's own social-responsibility team documented this in 2025, but orders were increased because these factories are the cheapest way to meet sales targets. Customers who asked about working conditions received a standard reply, and staff who raised the issue were moved to other roles. Company leadership knows about all of these practices. Fair Trade USA and the US Department of Labor have not been told.
